name: print-social-gradient-glow-ui-fragment-promo-calendar
title: Calendar UI Fragment on Aurora Gradient
whatItIs: A wide promo card showing two overlapping white UI panels, a date picker and a time selector, floating on a black field lit by blurred teal, blue and orange color glows at the edges.
whatItMeans: Isolating one feature as a crisp, oversized snippet makes a complex product feel simple and tangible. The dark glowing backdrop adds a sense of polish and modernity, and the white cards pop with maximum contrast.
techniques: Crop a real interface down to one or two components and enlarge them so the feature reads in a glance
Overlap two cards at different depths to imply a flow (choose a date, then a time)
Bleed soft colored glows in from the corners of a near-black field instead of using a full gradient
Use a single saturated accent (the blue selected date) as the only color inside the white UI
Leave generous dark margin so the fragment feels like a spotlit object
bestFor: Feature announcements and changelog posts on social
Product marketing cards for SaaS tools
Newsletter or blog header images that explain one capability

vocabulary.definition: A cropped, enlarged piece of an interface used as an illustration instead of a full screenshot.
Soft, blurred colored light bleeding in from the edges of a dark background.
Overlapping panels at staggered positions that suggest depth and sequence.
